name: goal-optimizer
description: A local-first, event-sourced goal optimization system: turn messy performances into traceable, recomputable capability estimates and see where the next unit of effort pays off most.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence → capability → gap: know where you are, and what to practice next.
interface.longDescription: A local-first, event-sourced goal optimization system. Record a performance, extract structured observations against a rubric, aggregate them deterministically into per-dimension capability estimates with confidence, and compare against your goal to see the highest-priority gap. Every number traces back to a line in the raw artifact and is byte-for-byte recomputable. v1 scope: backend system-design interviews.
defaultPrompt: Record my latest mock interview as evidence.
Assess my capabilities and show how far I am from my goal.
Explain why my idempotency.transfer score is what it is.
